environment.description: Same container image deployed as an AWS Lambda function (custom runtime, .NET 7 AOT) exposed exclusively via Lambda Function URL with AuthType set to AWS_IAM. The function URL resource policy specifies Principal: '*' with Condition aws:PrincipalOrgID matching 'o-a1b2c3d4e5' (organization boundary). The Lambda execution role has no VPC attachment and uses a resource policy that requires sigv4-signed requests. CloudWatch Logs show that unauthenticated HTTP requests to the function URL receive HTTP 403 {"Message":"Forbidden"} before reaching the Lambda handler. The function's reserved concurrency is set to 5 and has a 3-second timeout. No API Gateway or ALB sits in front of the function URL.
